mme.rationale: MME ladder 0.15/0.175/0.20 was sized at design time (zero GPU): per-observation binomial noise with n=1 probes per cluster-seed-arm binds detection below 0.80 at d 0.15 (row R5) and 0.175 (row R6); 0.20 is the smallest 0.05-step effect detectable at >= 0.80 on the conservative row (R2) — effects below 0.20 are NOT claimable at this design's power (declared limitation, cycle-2 / CONT-002 sizing precedent); 0.20 also clears the template section 9 guessing-band floor (>= 0.15).
